summary: Password reset (email + code) and Show Password features verified end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 new /app/backend/tests/test_password_reset.py pass on first run (14 tests covering forgot-password enumeration protection, single-row creation, 15-min expiry, 60s throttle, real Resend send, and reset-password happy path + session invalidation + no-reuse + 5-attempt lockout + expired-code purge + Pydantic 422s on short/long code + short pw). Regression: existing 30 email-auth + password-leak tests all still pass. Frontend: /login toggle-password-visibility flips input type between 'password' and 'text' on web build; forgot-password-link opens reset-panel; send-reset-code advances to reset-code-input + new-password-input + submit-reset + resend-reset-code + cancel-reset; 'Enter your email first' fires on empty email; inline errors fire for short code / short new password; full end-to-end reset (signup → forgot → seed hash for '123456' in Mongo → submit-reset → land in Garden with 'Meet your tree' modal + fresh session_token) succeeded; Google button still renders. NO hashed_password in reset-password response (recursive scan). All backend endpoints behave exactly as specified in the review request. Backend URL used: https://grow-by-goals.preview.emergentagent.com.

minor.issue: test_delivered_at_resend_no_logged_error flakes on repeated runs — Resend returns 429 'Too Many Requests' for delivered@resend.dev, and the /api/v1/email/send proxy surfaces that as 502 which is logged as 'reset email failed'. Not a code bug; Resend's own sandbox throttle. Passes first run in a session. If deterministic behavior is desired, backoff or a fresh throwaway to-address per run would help.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:278-317 /auth/forgot-password returns identical {'ok':True,'message':...} for known and unknown emails — enumeration-safe. Throttle uses created_at>now-1min so a second call within 60s never inserts a new row. Reset row correctly has code_hash, expires_at=+15min, attempts=0.

server.py:319-352 /auth/reset-password: verifies argon2 hash, purges the row on expiry / attempts>=5 / success (all reuse-safe), deletes ALL prior sessions for that user (user_sessions.delete_many), clears the login throttle counter, issues a fresh 30-day session, and returns {'session_token','user'} without hashed_password (users.find_one projection excludes it).

emailer.py:_assert_safe_email enforces no forms, no credential-asking phrases, https-only links, no shorteners/IP hosts, and anchor-text/href host match — solid phishing guard for outbound Sproutly mail.
login.tsx toggle-password-visibility drives secureTextEntry on both the login/signup password field AND the new-password-input in the reset panel (via shared showPassword state) — nice reuse.
login.tsx:34,49,50 client-side validation for 'Enter your email first', 6-digit code, and 8-char new password all fire before hitting the backend — matches the required inline auth-error copy.
